subject: Request to shift demo timing to allow prep and travel window for Finlytics

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Request to shift demo timing to allow prep and travel window for Finlytics

Hi Arman,

Quick note — I have a travel conflict that overlaps with our scheduled demo on Thu, Jul 15, and I want to be sure Diego (our Solutions Engineer) has enough time to review your sample data and run the prompt sets we discussed. To make the session productive for both sides we'd like to shift the demo to give us a 4–5 business day prep window.

Proposed options (all PT):
- Tue, Jul 21 — 10:00–11:00 or 15:00–16:00
- Wed, Jul 22 — 09:00–10:00 or 10:00–11:00

If none of those work for you, please suggest two alternative windows and we'll do our best to accommodate.

Notes/asks for prep:
- Can you share a small anonymized extract of the dataset (S3 presigned link or secure upload) so Diego can validate ingestion and latency on representative traces?
- If there are specific prompt examples or success criteria you want us to exercise, please attach them or paste them inline.
- Marissa (cc'd) will handle calendar/contract touches if we need to nudge procurement.

If you prefer, we can keep Jul 15 but shorten the agenda to an executive overview while we run a technical deep dive after we've had time to prep.

Thanks — apologies for the ask and for any inconvenience. Hoping one of the Jul 21–22 windows works.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Director, Solutions 
Redwood Inference

Laura — thanks for the heads up and no problem on the travel conflict. We definitely want the full technical walkthrough, so shifting makes sense.

Jul 22 10:00–11:00 PT looks promising from our side. I need to confirm with our data team about sharing a sample extract — they typically require a short approval but can push a small anonymized CSV to a secure folder. Procurement is looped in on this thread (procurement@finlytics.com) for the calendar/contract side.

Couple quick things for our side:
- We'll aim to share a 50–100 row anonymized extract (columns: txn_id, ts, user_segment, raw_text) by Mon 13 July EOD PT.
- If the SE needs a connection to an S3 bucket, let us know the preferred method (IAM role vs. presigned link).

I can tentatively pencil Jul 22 10:00–11:00 PT and will confirm after the data team okays the extract.

—Arman

Thanks Arman — Jul 22 10:00–11:00 PT works for us.

Technical asks to make the session productive:
- If you can upload the anonymized extract to a presigned S3 path that'd be fastest. If your security prefers, a secure file transfer link works too.
- I've attached a short prompt_examples.txt with the specific prompts we'll exercise, and a tiny workload_traces.csv that shows the token/sequence distributions we'd like to validate against. Could you confirm your data-team can map those columns?
- Diego will perform an ingest and run a couple of latency/cost profiles during our prep window; if an IAM role is easier for you to grant access, please CC the role ARN or the contact person.

I'll follow up with a calendar invite once you confirm the upload approach. Marissa will handle sending any contract addendum if procurement flags timing.

Subject: Re: Request to shift demo timing to allow prep and travel window for Finlytics

Arman / Laura — tagging in the SRE/ingest checklist to make this painless. If you can provide one of the following we can proceed:

Option A — presigned S3 link (preferred for a one-off extract):
- Put anonymized CSV at s3://finlytics-share/sample_data_v2.csv and send a presigned GET link valid for 72 hours.

Option B — cross-account access:
- Create an IAM role with read-only access and provide the role ARN + external ID. We'll assume role temporarily and pull the object.

Option C — secure upload:
- Drop in a secure transfer (SFTP/Transfer Family) and share credentials over your Okta-secured channel.

I've attached a short runbook that describes the exact columns we expect and a small ingestion script snippet we'll run. If you want us to anonymize further we can do that client-side; just confirm PII columns to drop.

Attachments: [Attachment: runbook.pdf (PDF, 58KB)]

Happy to jump on a quick call if the data-team prefers a handoff. Diego
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
